reason: This is exactly my problem on legacy migrations, but I can't put an unknown tool on a client's app this month. Security would ask what gets sent to Meta's models and whether recordings of client screens leave the machine, and I have no answer to show them.
objection: I don't believe it handles a real legacy app with logins, flaky data and weird old Windows screens. An AI-inferred list of business rules looks great in a demo and misses the edge cases that actually break in production.
would_change_my_mind: A published case study or a reproducible demo on a messy real-world legacy app, plus a clear statement that capture can run on local models with nothing leaving the machine, so I can get it past our security review.
